name: Tata Capital Ltd
title: Tata Capital Ltd - 544574 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Tata Capital FY26 book grew 20% (28% ex-motor finance) with Q4 credit cost down to 0.9% and cost-to-income 38.3%; FY28 targets of 23-25% growth and ~2% ROA reiterated, but no quantified capex or supply signal.

triggers.label: Q4 disbursements above INR50,000 crores
triggers.quote: Quarter four set a new benchmark with disbursements crossing INR50,000 crores, a first for the company

triggers.label: Credit cost 1.6% → 0.9% through FY26
triggers.quote: In quarter 1, it was 1.6% which dropped to 1.3% in quarter 2, dropped to 1.2% in quarter 3, and dropped to 0.9% in quarter 4.

triggers.label: Cost of funds guided lower in FY27
triggers.quote: our cost of funds for the next year FY27 should be lower than the cost of funds for FY26

triggers.label: Motor Finance AUM down 4% QoQ
triggers.quote: The AUM stood at INR25,390 crores, a sequential decline of 4% reflecting our fitness-first approach.

guidance.quote: the cost to income ratio stood at 38.3%, representing an improvement of 335 basis points over FY25
over the period of FY '25 to FY '28, we will grow at 23% to 25%

guidance.value: Growth to resume from 1H FY27; ROA of 2% by FY28
guidance.quote: we expect growth to resume from the first half of FY27
the right credit cost for us would be some 1% and which is the guidance which we have given

prior_guidance_check.quote: we have delivered on our targeted AUM growth, recording a 20% year -on-year increase in line with the guided range of 18% to 20%
profit after tax excluding non-recurring items grew 36%, exceeding our guidance of 32% to 35%
remaining comfortably within our guided range of 38% to 39%
our AUM growth was even stronger at 28% year-on-year, exceeding our guidance of 22% to 25%

red_flags.label: Motor finance AUM shrinking 4% QoQ, 24% in FY26
red_flags.quote: We did see a de-growth in our book by about 24% in Motor Finance business

red_flags.label: Incremental cost of borrowing up in March
red_flags.quote: we have seen an uptick in funding costs on incremental borrowings

evasions.quote: actually everybody defines red, amber very differently
It's very difficult to say at this point of time, but the direction will be as I communicated to you.
